text_block_list.text:
The day of the Sprinters Stakes has 
arrived. Seeing her own poster proudly 
plastered on the billboard, King Halo lets 
out a triumphant, boastful laugh.

Even when spotted by reporters who learned 
she had arrived, she remained totally 
composed. Acknowledging her fans' cheers 
as she headed to the waiting room, her 
popularity was steadily growing.

"'The Umamusume demanding the most 
attention is surely this one: the 
queen—nay, the King—who conquered the 
spring blitz!' The star of the autumn 
sprint championship will without a doubt 
be—"
Other than this King Halo, that is!
